title: Pets
goal: Ask about adopting an animal, describe a pet's observed problem, and ask for clear care information.

The fictional rescue has a cat named Luna. Staff have observed Luna living calmly with one other adult cat. They have no information about her experience with children. The visitor works from home and already has an adult cat.

runs.text: I'd like to ask about Luna. We already have an adult cat at home.

study.title: Describe a problem to a veterinary clinic

runs.text: , provides medical care for animals. Useful observations include
My puppy is much quieter than usual
means walking unevenly because a leg or foot is difficult to use. Report what you see and when it changed rather than supplying a diagnosis you do not know.

turns.speaker: Caller

runs.text: I'd like to speak to someone about my dog. He's limping and seems to avoid putting weight on his left front paw.

turns.en: I'd like to speak to someone about my dog. He's limping and seems to avoid putting weight on his left front paw.

turns.speaker: Clinic staff

runs.text: When did you first notice it?

turns.en: When did you first notice it?

turns.speaker: Caller

runs.text: This morning. I don't know what caused it.

turns.en: This morning. I don't know what caused it.

turns.speaker: Caller

runs.text: He's eating less than usual. Could you ask the vet how urgently he needs to be seen?

turns.en: He's eating less than usual. Could you ask the vet how urgently he needs to be seen?

turns.speaker: Staff

runs.text: I'll pass those details to the vet and ask them to speak with you.

turns.en: I'll pass those details to the vet and ask them to speak with you.

turns.speaker: Caller

runs.text: Thank you. My number is on his record. Could you confirm you have it?

turns.en: Thank you. My number is on his record. Could you confirm you have it?

distinguishes a guess from an observation.

turns.speaker: Owner

runs.text: Could you go over Luna's care and vaccination records with me?

turns.en: Could you go over Luna's care and vaccination records with me?

turns.speaker: Staff

runs.text: Yes. Which part would you like to discuss first?

turns.en: Yes. Which part would you like to discuss first?

turns.speaker: Owner

runs.text: This treatment entry. What is it for, and who should I ask about the next steps?

turns.en: This treatment entry. What is it for, and who should I ask about the next steps?

turns.speaker: Staff

runs.text: Let's check the record together and identify what the veterinary clinic needs to explain.

turns.en: Let's check the record together and identify what the veterinary clinic needs to explain.

turns.speaker: Owner

runs.text: I'd also like to check the microchip information. Who can confirm the identification and registration details?

turns.en: I'd also like to check the microchip information. Who can confirm the identification and registration details?

blocks.caption: Ask about care and records · Owner & Staff

runs.text: Which documents would this particular trip require, and where can I confirm the current requirements?
Do not treat one animal's care record as every animal's checklist.
Alone, read each staff prompt and answer from the supplied facts, then speak both roles.
You work from home and have an adult cat. Ask about Luna's observed behavior and adoption support. Reply as staff using only the rescue's stated information.
Your dog began limping this morning, avoids putting weight on the left front paw, and is eating less. Answer
Ask about the urgency of veterinary assessment.
You do not understand a treatment entry. Ask its purpose and who can explain the directions. Ask separately about microchip identification.

“We already have an adult cat. What have you observed about Luna with other cats?” / “We don't have information about her experience with children.” / “I noticed the limp this morning. He's also eating less. Could you ask the vet how urgently he needs to be seen?” / “What is this treatment for?”

Later, change the problem to a cat vomiting since last night. State the animal, observation and starting time without diagnosing it. Check whether you kept observed facts, uncertainty and requests for professional help distinct.
